name: hud_ui_text_input_destructor_core
description: HudUiTextInput::DestructorCore restores the base text-input function table and deletes the owned text buffer.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD text-input/widget class pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x4b4370 validate loading buffer from self+4, storing g_HudUiTextInput_FTable at self+0, and calling operator delete on the saved buffer.
The native smoke allocates an owned text buffer, calls DestructorCore, and validates the function table reset while preserving unrelated capacity and cursor fields.
